_comment: Per-state calling-window overrides in the PROSPECT's local time. Shape: {"XX": {"start": "HH:MM", "end": "HH:MM"}}. Top-level keys beginning with '_' are documentation and ignored by the loader. The default window (CALL_WINDOW_START..CALL_WINDOW_END, 09:00-17:00) is already stricter than the federal TCPA 8am-9pm rule and than most state telemarketing statutes, so this table ships with NO active overrides. Add an entry ONLY to narrow a state further; an override REPLACES the default for that state. VERIFY WITH COUNSEL before relying on, adding, or loosening anything here — this file is compliance input, not tuning.

_known_stricter_state_notes_verify_with_.AL: Alabama telemarketing statute limits calls to 8am-8pm local — the 09:00-17:00 default already complies; no override needed.
_known_stricter_state_notes_verify_with_.MS: Mississippi limits telemarketing to 8am-8pm — default already complies.
_known_stricter_state_notes_verify_with_.RI: Rhode Island limits telephone sales calls to 9am-6pm Mon-Fri (Saturday morning rules differ) — default weekday hours comply; weekend policy is a code-level knob, not a window override.
_known_stricter_state_notes_verify_with_.SC: South Carolina limits telemarketing to 8am-9pm — default already complies.
_known_stricter_state_notes_verify_with_.LA: Louisiana has additional holiday/disaster-declaration restrictions that a static window cannot express — handle operationally.
